label: Spotify
description: Official Spotify account integration for music search and playback control.

apps.label: Spotify
apps.description: Connect Spotify for playback status, search, and playback controls.

connectPrompt: Connect Spotify to allow playback-aware automations, track search, and playback controls from the agent.

tools.name: spotify_get_current_playback
tools.description: Get current playback state for the connected Spotify account. When multiple Spotify accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Spotify account email or identifier.

tools.name: spotify_get_recently_played
tools.description: Get recently played tracks for the connected Spotify account. When multiple Spotify accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Spotify account email or identifier.

tools.name: spotify_search
tools.description: Search Spotify catalog for tracks, albums, artists, or playlists. When multiple Spotify accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Spotify account email or identifier.

tools.name: spotify_control_playback
tools.description: Control Spotify playback: play, pause, next, previous, seek, set_volume, shuffle, or repeat. When multiple Spotify accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

action.description: Playback action: play, pause, next, previous, seek, set_volume, shuffle, repeat.

context_uri.description: Optional context URI for play action.

uris.description: Optional track URIs for play action.

position_ms.description: Optional playback offset in ms for play/seek.

mode.description: Repeat mode for repeat action: track, context, off.

account_email.description: Optional connected Spotify account email or identifier.

tools.name: spotify_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Spotify Web API request for advanced operations. When multiple Spotify accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Spotify account email or identifier.
